name: board-01
title: Board 01
description: A board page — a PageHeader over a FilterBar and Board, with lanes named by their count, a paged Backlog, cards that link to each task with their own menu, and a No matches state.

meta.whenToUse: A tasks or pipeline page laid out as lanes — copy it once and wire the filters, card links and moves to your data.
meta.whenNotToUse: A list with many columns of data — use a DataList page instead.
